MANDARIN — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #6
====

GRADE: Grade 8
SUBJECT: MANDARIN
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KJSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. When practising Interactive Speaking, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Copy random text without understanding Interactive Speaking.
   B. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Interactive Speaking.
   C. Use insults to “practise” Interactive Speaking.
   D. Avoid reading anything related to Interactive Speaking.

2. When practising Oral Expression, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Use insults to “practise” Oral Expression.
   B. Avoid reading anything related to Oral Expression.
   C. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Oral Expression.
   D. Copy random text without understanding Oral Expression.

3. When practising Listening for Information, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Copy random text without understanding Listening for Information.
   B. Use insults to “practise” Listening for Information.
   C. Avoid reading anything related to Listening for Information.
   D. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Listening for Information.

4. When practising Reading for Fluency, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Use insults to “practise” Reading for Fluency.
   B. Copy random text without understanding Reading for Fluency.
   C. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Reading for Fluency.
   D. Avoid reading anything related to Reading for Fluency.

5. When practising Active Listening, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Avoid reading anything related to Active Listening.
   B. Copy random text without understanding Active Listening.
   C. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Active Listening.
   D. Use insults to “practise” Active Listening.

6. In MANDARIN, the best classroom habit is: (1 mark)
   A. Only memorise without using the language
   B. Mix random languages with no purpose
   C. Practise listening, speaking, reading, and writing every day
   D. Avoid speaking to classmates

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
7. In three clear sentences, explain Active Listening and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

8. In three clear sentences, explain Active Listening and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

9. In three clear sentences, explain Interactive Speaking and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

10. In three clear sentences, explain Oral Expression and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

====

1. B — Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Interactive Speaking.

2. C — Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Oral Expression.

3. D — Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Listening for Information.

4. C — Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Reading for Fluency.

5. C — Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Active Listening.

6. C — Practise listening, speaking, reading, and writing every day
